interpretation: Lower penalty is better; require complete locally valid workload first. Local checker is not the reference validator. All runs are local M3 Pro/8 workers, not the 32-vCPU cloud target.
sourceProvenance: Measured the reconciled working tree during a pending merge. sourceSha256 covers solver, wrapper, canonical model/checker, requirements and inputs; the recorded HEAD revision alone does not identify that working tree.
retainedFields: All summary metrics except verbose checker detail and heuristic diagnostics. Local raw directories also contain selected and native schedule witnesses; reproduce them with the recorded config.

cohorts.timing: 60s is a per-scenario native solver limit; heuristic, imports, build and validation are additional and reported. Sequential runs. firstSolutionMs is a native-model candidate timestamp; estimatedPipelineMs sums independently timed stages.
cohorts.conformance: local checker; not reference validator; cross_possession_night_alignment undecidable
